name: RobStride 06
_comment_source: Mechanical/electrical figures from the published RobStride 06 datasheet table. Phase resistance, inductance and all thermal parameters are NOT published and are estimated by the tool - see the ASSUMED PARAMETERS section of any report.

gear_eff.note: back-solved from vendor Kt_out=1.1 Nm/Arms against Ke=7.6 Vrms/kRPM; Kt is only quoted to 2 s.f. so this is loosely bounded

Ke_Vrms_per_kRPM.note: datasheet back-EMF, line-to-line RMS per 1000 rotor rpm

I_peak_peak_amp.note: datasheet 'max load phase current' - needs a supply that can deliver it

kt_sat_derate.note: 36 Nm actual peak vs 44.3 Nm linear extrapolation of Kt; saturates harder than the RS00

tau_cont_out_spec.note: vendor 'rated load'; ambient and mounting unspecified

T_winding_max.note: Class B insulation (130 degC) less 10 degC design margin

notes: Vendor rated torque of 11 N.m is quoted with no stated ambient temperature or mounting condition, so it cannot be taken as a continuous rating in an enclosed robot. This tool computes the continuous limit from the thermal model instead.
Datasheet rated-load speed is only 100 rpm at the output, far below the 480 rpm no-load figure - the rated point is a thermal limit, not a voltage limit.
Peak phase current of 57 Apk demands serious power delivery; check bus wiring and battery C-rating, not just the actuator.
Dual 14-bit magnetic encoders, 1 Mbps CAN, FOC drive integrated. Class B insulation, -20 to 50 degC ambient per datasheet.
